identity.name: Heirloom
identity.mission: Privately preserve life stories and memories across generations.
identity.tone: Calm, Slow, Respectful, Nostalgic, Warm, Intimate, Legacy
identity.aesthetic: Apple Photos meets hardcover memoir meets quiet museum

headings.usage: All section titles, story titles, and emotional statements. MUST use tight tracking (-0.02em).

body.usage: UI elements, navigation, buttons, and long-form reading.

sizes.base: text-lg md:text-xl leading-relaxed (Elders need larger text)

special.usage: Personal notes, annotations on memory cards.

rules: NEVER use pure black (#000000). Use Deep Charcoal (#2C2420).
NEVER use pure white (#FFFFFF) for backgrounds. Use Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2).
Primary CTA buttons must be Muted Emerald (#2E5C55).
Use 'Paper' color (#FDFBF7) for cards to simulate physical stock.

layout.grid_system: The 'Bento' Grid Protocol (Mode A for Memories, Mode B for Tree)
layout.spacing: Generous. Use p-8 to p-12 for containers. Elders need touch targets of at least 48px.

containers.card: rounded-xl border border-[#E5E0D6] bg-[#FDFBF7] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300
containers.section: py-20 md:py-32 px-6 md:px-12 max-w-7xl mx-auto

buttons.primary: bg-[#2E5C55] text-[#F9F7F2] hover:bg-[#244A44] rounded-full px-8 py-4 text-lg font-medium shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all transform hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.secondary: bg-[#F0EBE0] text-[#2C2420] hover:bg-[#E5E0D6] rounded-full px-8 py-4 text-lg font-medium
buttons.ghost: text-[#2E5C55] hover:bg-[#F0EBE0]/50 rounded-full px-6 py-3 text-lg

inputs.style: bg-white/50 border border-[#E5E0D6] rounded-lg px-6 py-4 text-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2E5C55]/20 focus:border-[#2E5C55] transition-all placeholder:text-[#8C8580]

cards.memory: aspect-[3/4] bg-[#FDFBF7] p-6 rounded-xl shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(44,36,32,0.05)] border border-[#E5E0D6] relative overflow-hidden group cursor-pointer
cards.profile: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm p-8 rounded-2xl border border-[#E5E0D6] shadow-sm

voice_interface.mic_button: w-24 h-24 rounded-full bg-[#A55F5F] text-white flex items-center justify-center shadow-xl animate-pulse-slow hover:scale-105 transition-transform

textures.paper_overlay: url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1727195077380-1c0f7e7a3456?crop=entropy&cs=srgb&fm=jpg&q=85') opacity-5 mix-blend-multiply pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-50
textures.grain: Use a subtle SVG noise filter on backgrounds to reduce digital flatness.

motion.philosophy: Slow, Gentle, Organic. No sudden flashes.
motion.micro_interactions: Buttons should gently lift. Cards should breathe (scale 1.01) on hover.

media.rules: Images must have a 'sepia' or 'warm' filter applied via CSS (filter: sepia(0.2) contrast(0.95) brightness(1.05)) to match the heirloom aesthetic.

accessibility.voice_feedback: Visual ripples or glow when voice is active.
accessibility.font_sizing: Allow users to scale text up to 200% without breaking layout.

tech_stack.3d: React Three Fiber (for the Family Tree - optional, or use D3 for 2D organic tree)

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add 'Playfair Display' and 'Manrope' from Google Fonts immediately.
2. SETUP THEME: Configure tailwind.config.js with the 'Warm Ivory' palette defined above.
3. GLOBAL STYLES: Add the paper texture overlay to the body in index.css.
4. COMPONENT OVERRIDES: Customize all Shadcn components to remove sharp edges (use rounded-xl or rounded-full) and change borders to #E5E0D6.
5. LANDING PAGE: Build a cinematic landing page using the 'hero_family' image with a slow parallax effect.
6. FAMILY TREE: Create a 'Living Tree' component. If 3D is too complex, use a beautiful D3 force-directed graph with custom SVG nodes (photos in circles).
7. VOICE STUDIO: Create a dedicated page for recording with a massive, pulsing microphone button.
8. ACCESSIBILITY: Test every page at 125% zoom. Ensure no text overlaps.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' - no generic gradients or centered layouts.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid.
